title: The Window That Faces the Sunrise

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager finally has the sunrise window they wanted for years but feels strangely flat: think of the next thing, or enjoy it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For years (name1) has wanted a window in (his/her) hut facing east, so the morning sun would come in and wake (him/her) gently. Last week (he/she) finally cut one. This morning the sun came in exactly as planned and woke (him/her) gently, and it was lovely, and now (name1) is sitting on (his/her) mat feeling strangely flat. What does (he/she) want now?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) spends the morning thinking. A shelf. A better door. A garden outside the window. By lunchtime (he/she) has a whole new list. (He/she) enjoys the list very much. (He/she) suspects the list is the part (he/she) actually likes.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) decides not to want anything else for a while. (He/she) just enjoys the window. Every morning the sun comes in. Some mornings (he/she) is irritated by it and pulls the blanket over (his/her) head. Most mornings (he/she) isn't. It's a window. It's a good one. That's enough.
